prompts.name: eye-world-picasso
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create an original artistic AwakeVC Open Graph image, wide landscape approximately 1.905:1. Input is a reference/edit target for the IDEA, not a composition to merely recolor. Reinterpret its eye-as-world concept radically in the requested artist's visual language. The essential idea: one large eye contains a world of inhabited architectural pathways, tiny human builders, gardens and flowing water; its iris is a radiant sun; subtle networks and AI intelligence connect the living world. Keep a strong recognizable eye silhouette at social-thumbnail size, but redesign the forms and spatial logic. Crucially REMOVE all thick oil paint, impasto and chunky brush texture from the reference. Technology must be subtle and integral: tiny linked nodes, purposeful geometric spirits, information-like lines quietly woven into architecture. Not a sci-fi UI. Only text: a small tasteful "awake.vc" signature bottom left, within safe margins. No artist signatures, labels, code, robot heads, dashboards, neon cyberpunk. This is an original artwork, not a reproduction of any existing work. PABLO PICASSO / CUBISM. Bold, unmistakably Cubist reconstruction: flattened interlocking planes, fractured perspective, simultaneous viewpoints, angular architectural fragments, confident black contours, sculptural simplified figures. The eye is assembled from asymmetrical planes of city, bridges and faces; one crisp sun-disc iris anchors the composition. A sophisticated graphic collage and lithograph aesthetic, matte gouache-like flat fields and paper shapes, NO oil-paint surface. Warm ivory, ochre yellow and charcoal with assertive cobalt blue and terracotta accents. Rhythmic large shapes and selective detail, visually daring and modern. Fine black and gold connecting lines with tiny geometric nodes integrate subtly into the Cubist structures. Preserve the optimism and collaborative-world meaning; no conventional realistic fantasy city.

A lucid, uncanny dream rendered with exquisitely smooth surfaces, razor-sharp edges, meticulous detail and long theatrical shadows. The eye is a vast impossible architectural apparition floating over a silent ivory desert and mirrorlike sea; the upper lid is an impossibly slender inhabited bridge that bends like softened time, and the lower lid is a terrace of suspended gardens. Warm bone, amber gold, mineral blue, deep precise shadows, spacious eerie clarity. No thick paint, no impasto, no photographic CGI, no generic maximal fantasy city. Dalí-like surreal spatial invention without copying an existing composition.

This is an original artwork, not a reproduction of any existing work. M. C. ESCHER / IMPOSSIBLE GEOMETRY. An extraordinarily precise lithograph and wood engraving, primarily black ink on warm ivory paper with very restrained gold accents on the iris and tiny network nodes. The large eye is constructed from mathematically convincing impossible stairways, interlocking arches, bridges and aqueducts. Tiny human builders traverse different gravity orientations. Water flows through an impossible continuous loop. The iris is a circular recursive architectural aperture, luminous gold at its center. Tessellating architectural forms transform subtly into birds and linked geometric agents near the edges. Shared intelligence is embodied by the recursive spatial relationships and fine node connections, not an electronic overlay. Crisp crosshatching, meticulous linework, strong white/black masses, no painterly brushwork, no oil texture, no rainbow colors. One coherent eye-shaped architectural paradox that reads at thumbnail scale.
